about: The server's record of whose session it is: UserId and StartTime. Script Extender: ServerCCSessionOwner.

evidence.says: bg3.exe+0x3794650 (add helper, 0x10 bytes) initialises it from the global default UserID DAT_14617CEAC; bg3.exe+0x37A31D0 / bg3.exe+0x37ADDE0 store the requesting user's id; bg3.exe+0x316F540 reads it as 4 bytes for a user lookup; live 0x00010001
bg3.exe+0x3794650 sets it to 0; not written by the creators read; live 0
bg3.exe+0x37A31D0 and bg3.exe+0x37ADDE0: GetLocalTime -> struct tm -> _mktime64, stored as __time64_t at +8; live 0x6AF63E85 (a Unix time in 2026)
the game's executable keeps this type name among its ECS type names (gatekit symbols types)

in a change-appearance session (Osi.StartChangeAppearance on the host of a running level) it sits on the session entity; UserId reads 65537 for the host and StartTime a count of seconds of the wall clock at the start

open_questions: the byte at +4 (a flag) is never set in the code read
